newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rosneft names Warburg, ABN Amro debt issue advisers.
newsitem.headline: Rosneft names Warburg, ABN Amro debt issue advisers.

text.p: Russia's state oil holding company NK Rosneft, which the government intends to privatise this year, said on Tuesday it had appointed SBC Warburg to organise a short and long-term debt programme on international capital markets.
The first stage of this programme would involve raising short-term Euro paper, Rosneft spokesman Vladimir Tumarkin told Reuters.
ABN Amro would act as joint lead manager on this issue, he said.

Rosneft said this week it intended to raise capital by issuing various financial instruments possibly including Eurobonds. But it would not issue Eurobonds until Price Waterhouse has completed an audit to international accounting standards.
